|errata_history=This is version PC-E1 of [[Thrawn's Pet]], a title change (Thrawn's Pet → Thrawn's Ysalamir); it is the current card. The images are the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image, which print it. The release-sheet slip prints •Thrawn's Pet; see [[Thrawn's Pet]].
* '''Original''' ([[Thrawn's Pet]]): titled “•Thrawn's Pet” (no lore) on the Virtual Block 4 release sheet, slip 16: “Habitat: sites. Parasite: Imperials. While attached and present, at same site: all Force generation is canceled, Dark Jedi and Jedi are defense value -1 and their weapon destinies are -1, and no attacks.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 3, slip 16. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-16-Thrawns_Ysalamir.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list still showed the card under this title from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013.<ref name="cl-1240_17-old">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive; the same in the VMasterType list): “Thrawn's Pet”</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The rename is not in the [[Players Committee]]'s “New Persona Changes” list of 29 January 2013<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The PC website card list shows the new title by 15 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1240_17-new">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130315122117/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-03-15] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429051930/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive): “Thrawn's Ysalamir” (these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 16) prints the card as “•Thrawn's Ysalamir” (no lore)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=16 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Habitat: sites. Parasite: Imperials.
